intents.learning_objective: Define artificial intelligence and recognise tasks that require intelligent behaviour.
intents.assessment_focus: Recognize capabilities associated with intelligent systems: problem solving, reasoning, decision making, and learning.
intents.question_archetype: Capability recognition or simple interpretation without full-list recall.
required_concepts: intelligent systems use capabilities such as problem solving, reasoning, decision making, or learning
the correct option identifies or simply interprets an intelligent capability
prohibited_conflations: an unrelated computational capability is evidence of intelligence
every automated operation is artificial intelligence
generation_constraints: Assess recognition or simple interpretation at introductory difficulty.
Do not ask the learner to reproduce the entire capability list.
Use plausible non-AI or unrelated computational capabilities as distractors.
Provide exactly one unambiguous correct answer.

intents.learning_objective: Define artificial intelligence and recognise tasks that require intelligent behaviour.
intents.assessment_focus: Identify a concrete real-world application of artificial intelligence.
intents.question_archetype: Accessible scenario distinguishing an AI capability from ordinary fixed or non-adaptive processing.
required_concepts: a concrete AI application such as face recognition, game playing, speech processing, or route finding
the scenario requires an intelligent capability rather than fixed processing alone
prohibited_conflations: every automated system is artificial intelligence
fixed or non-adaptive processing alone establishes that a system is intelligent
generation_constraints: Distinguish an AI capability from ordinary fixed or non-adaptive processing.
Do not claim that every automated system is AI.
Provide exactly one unambiguous correct answer.

intents.learning_objective: Define artificial intelligence and recognise tasks that require intelligent behaviour.
intents.assessment_focus: Understand that an intelligent agent receives percepts from its environment and selects actions based on them.
intents.question_archetype: Accessible agent scenario testing the percept-to-action relationship.
required_concepts: an agent receives information or percepts from its environment
the agent selects an action based on those percepts
prohibited_conflations: an action is selected without regard to environmental input
formal tuple notation is required to understand the relationship
generation_constraints: Use an accessible agent scenario at introductory difficulty.
Test the relationship between an environmental percept and the selected action.
Do not require formal tuple notation.
Do not require memorization of a mathematical function definition.
Provide exactly one unambiguous correct answer.
